# Philip and the Ethiopian (Acts 8:29)

## Emotional Focus
Listening to God’s quiet voice and going where He says.

## Key KJV
“Then the Spirit said unto Philip, Go near, and join thyself to this chariot.” (Acts 8:29)

## Gentle Retelling
Philip heard God’s Spirit say to go to a chariot. He obeyed, helped the man understand the Bible, and the man believed in Jesus.

## Coloring Prompt
Philip running beside a chariot talking happily to the man inside.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Listen for God’s quiet voice — He has good plans.”
